Defines Go structs for deserializing SUSE OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) XML definitions, mapping the full `oval_definitions` document hierarchy into typed Go objects.

## Key Components

| Type | XML Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Root` | `oval_definitions` | Top-level document container |
| `Definition` | `definitions > definition` | Single vulnerability/patch definition with metadata |
| `Criteria` / `Criterion` | `criteria > criterion` | Recursive test evaluation logic |
| `Advisory` | `metadata > advisory` | Severity, CVEs, bugzillas, and CPE list |
| `Cve` | `advisory > cve` | CVE ID with CVSS3 score, impact, and reference URL |
| `RpminfoTest` | `tests > rpminfo_test` | RPM package test linking an object ref to a state ref |
| `RpminfoObject` | `objects > rpminfo_object` | RPM package name being evaluated |
| `RpminfoState` | `states > rpminfo_state` | Expected RPM version, arch, EVR, and signing key |

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "os"

    "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/oval/suse"
)

func main() {
    data, _ := os.ReadFile("suse-oval.xml")

    var root suse.Root
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    for _, def := range root.Definitions.Definitions {
        fmt.Printf("ID: %s | Title: %s | Severity: %s\n",
            def.ID,
            def.Title,
            def.Advisory.Severity,
        )
        for _, cve := range def.Advisory.Cves {
            fmt.Printf("  CVE: %s | CVSS3: %s\n", cve.CveID, cve.Cvss3)
        }
    }
}
```

> **Note:** `Criteria` is self-referential — it embeds `[]Criteria` — allowing arbitrarily nested AND/OR operator trees as used in OVAL evaluation logic.
